{{Top|leg}}
The '''Oldsters''' were a group of individuals living on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] who were the last surviving members of one of the [[Colony ship/Legends|colony ships]] that settled the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], only three remained alive: [[Heff (Lepi)|Heff]], [[Slag Flats]], and Old [[Arno (Tatooinian)|Arno]]. During the [[Escape from Tatooine|bounty hunt]] for famed [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] hero [[Adar Tallon/Legends|Adar Tallon]], Heff and Flats were both killed by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] searching for Tallon. Old Arno helped [[Agent/Legends|agents]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] find Tallon.<ref name="TM">''[[Tatooine Manhunt]]''</ref>
